title: Strategy & Decision Making Adventure 3: Decision Trees & Growth
welcome_lead: Today you'll roll a decision tree and choose between organic and external growth.
meta_desc: IBDP Business Management Strategy: decision trees with expected values and methods of growth.
final_note: You computed expected values on a decision tree and compared organic vs external growth.

concepts.def: Two firms combine on equal terms

walkthroughs.body_html:
Decision trees mix choice and chance.

Squares are decisions; circles are chance events. Each branch has a probability and payoff.

Expected Value = Σ(probability × payoff). Roll back from right to left, choosing the highest EV at each square.

Launch product (cost $100k). Success (p=0.6) → $250k. Failure (p=0.4) → $0.

EV = (0.6×250) + (0.4×0) − 100 = 150 − 100 = $50k.

Strength: forces probabilities into the open. Weakness: probabilities are estimates and trees ignore risk attitude.

Organic: open new branches, new products. Slow but controlled.

External:

- Merger — equals combine (Daimler-Chrysler).
- Acquisition — buyer takes over target (Disney + Pixar).
- Joint venture — separate jointly-owned entity.
- Strategic alliance — looser cooperation.
